title: DIS solicitation handling
notes: Python and Rust solicitation handling implemented and green. Remaining all-implementation blockers: (1) Zephyr has no DIS codec or solicitation handler (only a header comment; project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.5.6.3.3 remains open), so multicast Trickle reset and unicast configured-DIO response cannot be validated there. (2) canonical test/vectors/rpl_messages.json case dis_solicited_no_dodagid_match is malformed against RFC 6550 6.7.9: option Data Length is 18 and omits the required final Version Number byte; generator carries the same defect. In-scope gates: Python RPL 629 passed; Ruff/mypy clean. Rust lichen-rpl 194 unit + 38 integration passed, doc test ignored; clippy -D warnings, rustfmt, and no_std check green.
